mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals improved labor market conditions, raising corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods of PAYEMS acceleration, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the S&P CoreLogic Home Price Index exceeding 3% indicates weakening housing demand, reducing household wealth and discretionary spending, and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 0% signals weakening manufacturing activity, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO contraction, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS tightening, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressure and input costs, reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k combined with a 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a synchronized labor market tightening, raising wage pressure and input costs, and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods of synchronized labor market tightening, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
